name: Clear Air

color_effect.warm_light_response: colors render true; warm light stays warm
color_effect.daylight_response: full color, deep shadows, maximum contrast

time_of_day_interactions.dawn: crisp horizon line, pink and orange bands cleanly separated
time_of_day_interactions.midday: intense clarity, hard shadows with knife edges
time_of_day_interactions.golden_hour: pure warm light, long clean shadows
time_of_day_interactions.night: stars sharp as needles, darkness total between light sources

prose_fragments: the air so clear it feels like looking through nothing at all
every edge a razor cut against the sky
distance rendered in perfect detail, the far mountains as sharp as your own hand

physics_notes: Rayleigh scattering only. No particulate attenuation.

name: Light Haze

color_effect.cool_light_response: cool tones slightly milky at distance
color_effect.daylight_response: sky pales near horizon; distant colors lose saturation

time_of_day_interactions.dawn: gentle wash of color, horizon softened
time_of_day_interactions.midday: sky whitens near horizon, shadows slightly soft
time_of_day_interactions.golden_hour: warm light scattered wider, glow effect enhanced
time_of_day_interactions.night: distant lights slightly fuzzy, sky glow from cities more visible

prose_fragments: the far hills fading to watercolor suggestions
air with just enough body to soften the world's edges
a gentle veil over distance, like memory softening a photograph

physics_notes: Fine aerosol or humidity. Mie scattering begins but Rayleigh still dominant.

name: Light Fog

color_effect.warm_light_response: glow diffuses into halo; warm tones bleed outward
color_effect.cool_light_response: cold light turns milky; sources become indistinct
color_effect.daylight_response: sky goes flat white; colors muted; distances compress

time_of_day_interactions.dawn: fog catches first pink light; world is cotton and rose
time_of_day_interactions.golden_hour: fog turns gold; light sources become molten orbs
time_of_day_interactions.night: each streetlight wears a crown of diffused light; darkness absolute between

prose_fragments: the world ending softly twenty meters out
sound and sight equally dampened
buildings emerging from white like developing photographs

physics_notes: Mie scattering from water droplets (1-10μm). Wavelength-independent → white/grey.

name: Heavy Fog

color_effect.warm_light_response: light becomes a formless orange glow, source invisible
color_effect.cool_light_response: white-on-white; sources vanish into general luminance
color_effect.daylight_response: no sky visible; light comes from everywhere and nowhere

time_of_day_interactions.dawn: pure white void with occasional pink warmth
time_of_day_interactions.midday: shadowless white — impossible to tell direction of sun
time_of_day_interactions.golden_hour: amber suffusion, the fog itself glowing
time_of_day_interactions.night: visibility collapses to arm's length; lights are floating halos

prose_fragments: the world reduced to what you can touch
shapes appearing and vanishing like thoughts
walking through a cloud brought down to earth

physics_notes: Dense water droplets. Multiple scattering dominates.

name: Rain

color_effect.warm_light_response: warm light fragmenting in droplets, reflections doubled on wet surfaces
color_effect.cool_light_response: cool tones intensified; everything shinier, more saturated when wet
color_effect.daylight_response: overcast canopy; diffuse light; colors actually deepen on wet surfaces

time_of_day_interactions.dawn: grey-pink sky, everything gleaming and dripping
time_of_day_interactions.midday: dark canopy pressing down, puddles reflecting grey sky
time_of_day_interactions.golden_hour: rare — when sun breaks through rain: rainbows, wet gold, magical
time_of_day_interactions.night: every surface becomes a mirror; lights doubled, tripled in wet streaks

prose_fragments: rain drawing silver lines through the air
every surface slicked and doubled — the world and its wet reflection
light fractured in a thousand running droplets

physics_notes: Large droplets (0.5-5mm). Refraction creates rainbows. Wet surfaces increase specularity.

name: Falling Snow

color_effect.warm_light_response: snowflakes catch warm light and glow like descending embers
color_effect.cool_light_response: snow turns blue-white, crystalline, cold beauty
color_effect.daylight_response: ground brightness increases dramatically; sky and ground merge

time_of_day_interactions.dawn: pink snow, blue shadows, crystalline silence
time_of_day_interactions.midday: blinding white ground, grey-white sky — horizon disappears
time_of_day_interactions.golden_hour: golden snowflakes, amber-painted drifts, blue shadows
time_of_day_interactions.night: snow glows faintly, reflecting any light; flakes visible in every light cone

prose_fragments: the world going quiet under a blanket of white
each flake a tiny mirror catching whatever light there is
sky and ground conspiring to erase the horizon

physics_notes: Ice crystals, highly reflective. Ground albedo jumps to 0.8-0.9.

name: Dust / Sand Haze

color_effect.cool_light_response: cool tones neutralized, dragged toward yellow-brown
color_effect.daylight_response: sun turns into a pale disc; sky goes yellow-grey; apocalyptic

time_of_day_interactions.midday: pale disc overhead, yellow-grey sky, visibility collapsing
time_of_day_interactions.golden_hour: indistinguishable from the dust color — everything sepia
time_of_day_interactions.night: dust catches distant lights, sky glows brown over cities

prose_fragments: the air itself turned to sand
everything filtered through amber, like a photograph from another century
grit between your teeth, the horizon erased

physics_notes: Large mineral particles. Absorb blue, pass red/yellow. Strong extinction.

name: Smoke Haze

color_effect.cool_light_response: cool tones killed; everything shifts orange-brown
color_effect.daylight_response: sun turns red-orange; sky goes pale brown; shadows softened

time_of_day_interactions.dawn: blood-red sun, sky like bruised flesh
time_of_day_interactions.midday: dim orange noon, shadows weak and diffuse
time_of_day_interactions.golden_hour: indistinguishable — the smoke makes every hour look like end times
time_of_day_interactions.night: sky glows dull orange from reflected city light; stars invisible

prose_fragments: the sun a dull red coin you can stare at directly
everything tinted sepia-orange, like the world is ending in slow motion
the smell reaches you before the haze does

physics_notes: Carbon particles + organic aerosols. Strong blue absorption. Wildfire smoke can reduce visibility to <1km.

name: High Humidity

color_effect.warm_light_response: warmth enhanced; air feels thick with golden light
color_effect.daylight_response: air shimmers over hot surfaces; distant objects waver

time_of_day_interactions.dawn: mist clinging to low ground, burning off slowly
time_of_day_interactions.midday: heat shimmer over pavement, air thick and visible
time_of_day_interactions.golden_hour: humid air turns golden light into something you can almost drink
time_of_day_interactions.night: halos around every light, dampness visible in headlight beams

prose_fragments: the air has weight — you can feel it on your skin and see it in the light
everything slightly soft, slightly hazy, like the world is sweating
light travels through the wet air like honey through water

physics_notes: Water vapor absorbs some IR, scatters visible light mildly. Above 80% RH, visible haze.

name: Dawn Atmosphere

color_effect.cool_light_response: western sky stays blue while east goes pink; temperature contrast
color_effect.daylight_response: rapidly brightening; shadows retreating; colors awakening

prose_fragments: the world rinsed clean and lit from below
colors returning to things one by one as the light strengthens
dew catching the first light like scattered diamonds

physics_notes: Low sun angle. Cool air often holds morning mist. Rayleigh scattering at extreme path length.

name: Noon Atmosphere

color_effect.warm_light_response: true rendering under neutral overhead light
color_effect.cool_light_response: full blue-sky bounce fill from above
color_effect.daylight_response: maximum intensity, maximum color accuracy, harshest shadows

prose_fragments: the sun hammering straight down, no place to hide
colors bleached by sheer intensity
shadows puddled directly beneath everything, tight and dark

physics_notes: Minimum atmospheric path length. True D55-D65 illumination.

name: Dusk Atmosphere

color_effect.warm_light_response: warm artificial lights emerging as sky cools — temperature contrast maximized
color_effect.cool_light_response: cool tones deepen, blue hour approaching
color_effect.daylight_response: fading fast; colors losing saturation; artificial lights gaining dominance

experiential.feel: transitional, wistful, the day letting go
prose_fragments: the golden last gasp giving way to blue
warm lights winking on inside windows as the sky dims
that narrow window when the sky and the streetlights are the same brightness

physics_notes: Transition from solar to artificial illumination. Rapidly changing color temperature.

name: Clear Night

color_effect.warm_light_response: warm sources become beacons in the void — sharp, isolated, precious
color_effect.cool_light_response: cool light reads as natural in the dark; less jarring than by day

experiential.feel: vast, exposed, intimate in pools of light
prose_fragments: darkness is not empty — it's a presence, a weight
pools of artificial light become islands in an ocean of black
the eye adapts, and slowly the dark reveals its secrets

physics_notes: No solar illumination. Scotopic vision dominates. Color perception severely reduced.

name: Afternoon Atmosphere

color_effect.warm_light_response: warmth beginning to build as sun angle lowers
color_effect.cool_light_response: shadows starting to cool and lengthen
color_effect.daylight_response: rich, warm, the best light for seeing true color

experiential.feel: full, warm, the peak of the day's story
prose_fragments: sun slanting lower, shadows stretching, colors deepening
the light thickening toward gold as afternoon wears on
warm amber creeping into what was neutral white

physics_notes: Sun 20-40° elevation. Slightly longer atmospheric path than noon.

name: Morning Atmosphere

color_effect.warm_light_response: warmth still carries the sunrise, fading toward neutral
color_effect.cool_light_response: fresh, clean cool light — shadows still blue-tinged
color_effect.daylight_response: brightness building, dew still catching light, fresh

prose_fragments: clean light still warming up, dew drying on every surface
shadows retreating as the sun climbs, the world expanding
the crispness of new light on wet surfaces

physics_notes: Sun 10-30° elevation. Often residual morning moisture in air.
